# netbox_ipsec_profile (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
// Get IPSec profile by name
data "netbox_ipsec_profile" "test" {
  name = "my-ipsec-profile"
}

// Get IPSec profile by id
data "netbox_ipsec_profile" "test" {
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) At least one of `id` or `name` must be given.
- `name` (String) At least one of `id` or `name` must be given.
- `tags` (Set of String)

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String)
- `description` (String)
- `ike_policy_id` (Number)
- `ipsec_policy_id` (Number)
- `mode` (String)
